english.title: Make a false statement in application for conversion of a club certificate - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly or recklessly made a false statement, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSE STATEMENT..), in or in connection with an application for the conversion of an existing club certificate in respect of **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..)
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 22 of Schedule 8 to the Licensing Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Sub-paragraph 22(2) provides that for the purposes of sub-paragraph 22(1) a person is to be treated as making a false statement if he produces, furnishes, signs or otherwise makes use of a document that contains a false statement.
